name: Block a user from an organization
description: Block a user from an organization Blocks the given user on behalf of the specified organization and returns a 204. PUT /orgs/{org}/blocks/{username}

name: Check if a user is blocked by an organization
description: Check if a user is blocked by an organization Returns a 204 if the given user is blocked by the given organization. GET /orgs/{org}/blocks/{username}

name: List users blocked by an organization
description: List users blocked by an organization List the users blocked by an organization. GET /orgs/{org}/blocks
context:
GET /orgs/{org}/blocks
List the users blocked by an organization.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
Optional: per_page (query) — The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; page (query) — The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

name: Unblock a user from an organization
description: Unblock a user from an organization Unblocks the given user on behalf of the specified organization. DELETE /orgs/{org}/blocks/{username}
